package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) A(_ context.Context) string { return "a" }

func (Server) B(_ context.Context) string { return "b" }
